issues.title: Final gate and handler routing can disagree on domain versus typed plan identity
issues.resolution: A single canonical resolver now validates registered domain/typedKind pairs, derives the actual side effect and operation types, and supplies the only domain used by handler routing. Invalid identity cannot reach a protected handler.

issues.title: Legacy ActionIntent can self-declare a read_only side-effect class instead of using authoritative registry metadata
issues.resolution: Legacy identity and side-effect authority now resolve through the existing public action-intent registry. Missing/unregistered actions fail closed, conflicting identifiers fail closed, and supplied side-effect metadata must exactly match the registry.
